desc: Redraw this flame hawk as a detailed 16-bit indie game sprite: realistic hawk proportions, same face, red and orange feathers with a flame crest, small plain eyes, same pose and silhouette. Muted natural palette, thin dark navy outline, 3-4 shade steps with pixel clusters, deeper shadows under head and belly, highlights on flame crest and wings, subtle feather shading. No gradients, no ground shadow.
